description: Send a direct message in an existing inbox conversation. The conversation_id comes from social_api_list_conversations. Specify the account_id to send from. Max 1000 characters. Consumes 1 interaction credit. On Facebook Messenger, messages can only be sent within 24 hours of the user's last message to you (platform policy). Supported on Instagram and Facebook.

account_id.description: Connected account ID to send from
